summary:
quality lens over frontend-shell-login (22 product path(s), b0b62bc..10f7be4, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 0 blocking, 3 non-blocking. The shell and core authentication flow are substantially implemented, but logout can leave a valid hidden session and two normative login requirements are violated.
VERDICT t8-c1: implemented — frontend/app/globals.css:154 and frontend/tailwind.config.ts:14 implement the token-based responsive shell and ink mapping.
VERDICT t8-c2: partial — frontend/src/components/shell/app-shell.tsx:37 redirects after failed logout without confirming session invalidation.
VERDICT t8-c3: partial — frontend/src/features/auth/login-form.tsx:12 has incorrect required copy, and frontend/src/features/auth/login-form.tsx:133 does not restore OTP-field focus after resend.
VERDICT t8-c4: implemented — frontend/src/components/shell/app-shell.tsx:11 defines exactly five items, with only Dashboard active and the remaining controls rendered unavailable.

blocking_findings.summary: t8-c2: email+OTP login works end-to-end under the spec's local runtime contract: a successful verification lands in the shell, logout returns to /login, and an access-token 401 retries once through POST /api/auth/refresh before falling back to /login. The client (frontend/src/lib/api.ts) uses credentials:'include' against the auth allow-list (GET /api/auth/csrf bootstrap, POST otp/request, POST otp/verify, GET me, POST refresh, POST logout) and sends x-csrf-token re-read from the current 3f_csrf cookie immediately before EVERY mutating request (never cached); server state is TanStack Query (me as a query the route guard reads, otp/logout as mutations that prime/invalidate it)

t8-c3: the login screen implements the spec's normative Login screen contract (docs/specs/app-platform-base.md §Login screen contract): a split screen from _ds tokens (left Deep Forest #0C3529 brand panel with the '3F Financial MIS' wordmark + one value line, Mint #6AF1B0 as a thin on-dark accent only; right a white card on the Off-White canvas; brand panel stacks above the card at 390x844), the two-step flow (email type=email autocomplete=email + Emerald #1C6B49 'Send code' 44px at radius-md; then a 6-digit field inputmode=numeric autocomplete=one-time-code client-validated /^\d{6}$/ with Emerald 'Verify', a 'Use a different email' back link and 'Resend code'), the load-bearing uniform copy ('If that email has access, a code is on its way.' / 'That code didn't match - check it or resend.'), and the accessibility (real <label>s, aria-live=polite acks/errors, focus to the code field after Send and to the first error on failure, :active feedback, ease-out <=200ms entry transitions, prefers-reduced-motion respected), verified by the user-facing functional check at 1440x900 and 390x844

non_blocking_findings.summary: Do not report logout complete when the server request fails (frontend/src/components/shell/app-shell.tsx:37): The `onSettled` callback removes the local session and redirects even when `api.logout` rejects, including when the request never reaches the server.
Restore focus to the OTP field after resending (frontend/src/features/auth/login-form.tsx:133): The resend handler calls `sendCode` while the component is already on the `code` step.

Use the required invalid-code text verbatim (frontend/src/features/auth/login-form.tsx:12): The normative, acceptance-critical message is `That code didn't match - check it or resend.`, but this constant substitutes an em dash.

frontend/src/features/auth/login-form.tsx:12 has incorrect required copy, and frontend/src/features/auth/login-form.tsx:133 does not restore OTP-field focus after resend.
